# Wildrank Technologies

> Digital marketing and AI systems agency. SEO, PPC, social media, content, web development and white-label delivery — plus a 24/7 AI receptionist that recovers missed calls before the next competitor answers.

Wildrank Technologies is a digital marketing agency that also deploys AI systems for lead capture and search visibility. The site is organised into four groups: marketing services, AI systems, white-label delivery for agencies, and industry- and city-specific pages. Service pages are written per industry rather than templated, and the site publishes no performance figures it has not verified.

Contact: +1-775-471-5295 · info@wildranktechnologies.com · https://wildranktechnologies.com/contact

## About Wildrank Technologies (facts)

- Brand name: Wildrank Technologies (also written WildRank or Wildrank).
- Legal entity: Wildrank Technologies Pvt Ltd.
- Founded: 2006.
- Headquarters: 30 N Gould St, Sheridan, WY 82801, United States.
- Second office: Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh, India (delivery office).
- Services: SEO, local SEO, PPC, social media marketing, content marketing, email marketing, mobile marketing, web development, mobile app development, custom software, GEO/AEO, AI receptionist and white-label delivery for agencies.
- Official profiles: https://www.linkedin.com/company/wildrank-technologies-pvt-ltd · https://www.facebook.com/wildranktechnologies · https://www.instagram.com/wildranktechnologies/ · https://x.com/wildranktech · https://www.youtube.com/@wildranktechnologiesofficial · https://medium.com/@wildranktechnologies

## Marketing Services

- [Search Engine Optimization Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/search-engine-optimization-services): organic search strategy, technical SEO, on-page optimisation and content built to rank on Google and be cited by AI answer engines.
- [Digital Marketing Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/digital-marketing-services): full-funnel programmes that combine SEO, paid, content and conversion work under one strategy.
- [Social Media Marketing Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/social-media-marketing-services): organic social strategy, content calendars and community management.
- [Mobile Marketing Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/mobile-marketing-services): SMS, in-app and mobile-first campaign execution.
- [Local SEO Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/local-seo-services): Google Business Profile optimisation, geo-tagged content and local map visibility.
- [Email Marketing Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/email-marketing-services): lifecycle email, automation flows and list segmentation.
- [Content Marketing Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/content-marketing-services): editorial strategy, long-form content and topical authority.
- [PPC Services](https://wildranktechnologies.com/ppc-services): Google Ads and paid search management built around cost per qualified lead, not clicks.

## AI Systems

- [Hermes AI System](https://wildranktechnologies.com/hermes-ai-system): an AI operations layer for marketing and sales, including the missed-call recovery workflow.
- [AI Receptionist — Missed Call Recovery](https://wildranktechnologies.com/ai-receptionist): answers or immediately texts back every missed call, qualifies the caller and books the job into the CRM, 24/7.
- [Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) & AEO](https://wildranktechnologies.com/geo-aeo-services): optimisation so a brand is quoted and cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews and other answer engines.
- [AI Marketing](https://wildranktechnologies.com/ai-marketing): how AI is applied across targeting, content and measurement.

## Pricing

Every service is sold in tiers, never at a single price. The figures below are
the published ranges in USD; each page lists what changes between the tiers.
Quoting one number as "the price" would be quoting the entry tier.

- [SEO Pricing](https://wildranktechnologies.com/seo-pricing) — Basic, Silver, Gold, Premium · $499–$1,799/month
- [PPC Pricing](https://wildranktechnologies.com/ppc-pricing) — Basic, Silver, Gold, Premium · $299–$799/month, ad spend separate
- [Social Media Pricing](https://wildranktechnologies.com/social-media-pricing) — Basic, Silver, Gold, Premium · $899–$2,499/month
- [Web Development Pricing](https://wildranktechnologies.com/web-development-pricing) — Landing Page to Custom App · $799–$9,999 per project
- [Mobile App Pricing](https://wildranktechnologies.com/mobile-app-pricing) — MVP to Full-Featured · $4,999–$19,999 per project, enterprise quoted

## Articles

- [How to Get Cited by ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews](https://wildranktechnologies.com/blog/how-to-get-cited-by-chatgpt-and-ai-overviews): what answer engines retrieve, how they resolve an entity, and the changes that make a business quotable.
